    [From exchangerates.org.uk](https://www.exchangerates.org.uk/news/47401/2026-10-10-british-pound-november-bank-of-england-rate-hike-expected-says-mufg.html)

    https://www.exchangerates.org.uk/news/47401/2026-10-10-british-pound-november-bank-of-england-rate-hike-expected-says-mufg.html

    MUFG expects the Bank of England to begin raising interest rates in November, adding support for Sterling against the Euro as investors weigh France’s fiscal difficulties against the UK’s own approaching Budget. The Pound to Euro exchange rate ended Friday near €1.1814, up around 0.9% since the start of October. The government must also avoid unsettling bond investors with its 28 October Budget. Lee Hardman, MUFG’s senior currency analyst, wrote on 8 October: “The pound has strengthened sharply against the euro since the end of last month as the euro sell-off has broadened out.
